result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Melbourne. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If you were injured in a **car accident in Melbourne**, you’ll generally be dealing with Victoria’s **Transport Accident Commission (TAC)** scheme. TAC specifically recommends using a personal-injury lawyer who specialises in TAC claims and participates in the **Common Law Protocols**. [www.tac.vic.gov.au](https://www.tac.vic.gov.au/clients/how-we-can-help/compensation/common-law-compensation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.tac.vic.gov.au](https://www.tac.vic.gov.au/clients/how-we-can-help/compensation/common-law-compensation/common-law-fact-sheets/how-to-find-and-choose-a-lawyer?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Firms I’d shortlist

- Arnold Thomas & Becker Lawyers Melbourne — particularly worth considering for TAC/road-accident claims. They have a dedicated TAC practice, offer a free claim check, and state that they operate under the TAC Protocols. [www.arnoldthomasbecker.com.au](https://www.arnoldthomasbecker.com.au/tac-claim-check/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Gordon Legal Melbourne — dedicated road-accident/TAC lawyers, including assistance with medical expenses, lost income and potential lump-sum/common-law compensation. [gordonlegal.com.au](https://gordonlegal.com.au/services/road-accident-tac/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Slater and Gordon Lawyers — a large personal-injury practice with a dedicated Victorian motor-vehicle/TAC team. Their Melbourne team offers an obligation-free initial appointment and can meet by video, at home or in hospital. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/motor-vehicle-accidents/car-accident-lawyers-in-melbourne?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Melbourne — another established Melbourne personal-injury firm worth getting a competing assessment from.
- Arnold Dallas McPherson Injury Lawyers Melbourne — another Melbourne personal-injury option if you'd like to compare several firms.

**My first three calls would be Arnold Thomas & Becker, Gordon Legal and Slater & Gordon.** I wouldn't choose purely on Google ratings; ask each lawyer specifically about their experience with **TAC serious-injury/common-law claims similar to yours**.

### One important distinction

TAC can provide **no-fault benefits** such as treatment and income support even where you contributed to causing the accident. If your injuries are serious and another person was at fault (or partly at fault), you may potentially have a **common-law compensation claim** for things such as pain and suffering and past/future loss of earnings. [www.tac.vic.gov.au](https://www.tac.vic.gov.au/clients/how-we-can-help/compensation/common-law-compensation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

TAC says you can get a **free half-hour consultation** through a lawyer you choose, and you should ask about the total legal costs and whether the firm follows the Common Law Protocols. [www.tac.vic.gov.au](https://www.tac.vic.gov.au/clients/how-we-can-help/compensation/common-law-compensation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.tac.vic.gov.au](https://www.tac.vic.gov.au/clients/how-we-can-help/compensation/common-law-compensation/common-law-fact-sheets/how-to-find-and-choose-a-lawyer?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **(1) when the accident happened, (2) whether you were the driver/passenger/pedestrian, (3) roughly what injuries you suffered, and (4) whether the other driver was at fault**, I can narrow this down to **2–3 lawyers that look best suited to your particular claim** and give you their contact details.
